نضوا (form I)
# نَضُّوا (naḍḍū) /nadˤ.dˤuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of نَضَّ (naḍḍa)
# نُضُّوا (nuḍḍū) /nudˤ.dˤuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of نَضَّ (naḍḍa)
# نِضُّوا (niḍḍū) /nidˤ.dˤuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of نَضَّ (naḍḍa)
